opening.argument: The presentation ties earning money from OneCoins to selling through an internal platform while acknowledging that there is no free trade. It cites a 5,000-euro investment as supporting up to 60 euros in daily profit, and instructs viewers to log in daily and continue selling. The displayed sell-order panel reinforces that pitch with fields for coin amounts, transaction values, fees, expiry, and a transaction password. At the same time, the internal market is described as having “extreme restrictions.” The presentation then directs viewers toward Bitcoin-mining recommendations at Deutschlandteam.nl. These features present a token-purchase and appreciation opportunity, but they do not establish website behavior, completed transactions, realized returns, or user losses.
